import gzip
import shelve
from dataclasses import dataclass, field


class Store:
    __match_args__ = ("archive",)
    archive: gzip.GzipFile
    shelf: shelve.Shelf[str]


def inspect(store: Store) -> None:
    match store:
        case Store((head, *tail)):
            pass
    match store:
        case Store(shelf={"decision": value}):
            pass


@dataclass
class GeneratedStore:
    shelf: shelve.Shelf[str]


def inspect_generated(store: GeneratedStore) -> None:
    match store:
        case GeneratedStore({"decision": value}):
            pass


@dataclass
class ConfiguredStore:
    ignored: shelve.Shelf[str] = field(init=False)
    keyword_only: shelve.Shelf[str] = field(kw_only=True)
    archive: gzip.GzipFile = field()


def inspect_configured(store: ConfiguredStore) -> None:
    match store:
        case ConfiguredStore((head, *tail)):
            pass
